identity: Highcourt is safe inside its walls; outside them, private collectors dress their charges as royal tolls.

quests.title: The Dead Cannot Owe Toll
quests.text: There are Debtbound Zombies wandering the {name:commons}, {zone_area:commons}, at night, still burdened with somebody's unpaid tolls. Put five to rest after dark. Penn's name keeps appearing in the complaints, and I intend to learn why. Highcourt can surely spare the dead another demand for payment.
quests.lesson: Night work near the capital; zombies burn at dawn.

quests.title: An Arrow Is Not a Receipt
quests.text: The complaints lead to Toll Bandit Archers in the {name:deer_park} {dir_of:highcourt:deer_park}, collecting after dark from anyone unfortunate enough to pass. Defeat five there at night. Their badges claim royal authority; the crown's instructions do not include shooting customers.
quests.lesson: Ranged night roster in a forest; daytime there is quiet.

quests.title: Optional: Tithes After Dark
quests.text: The petitions now include Tithe Revenants in the {name:orchards}, which lie {zone_area:orchards}. They rise at night to demand payments nobody remembers owing. Lay five of them to rest after dark. I would prefer the dead stop collecting before the living start believing them.
quests.lesson: Optional: a night hunt beside the day orchard work.

quests.title: The Last Unauthorised Stamp
quests.text: {name:tollmaster_penn} conducts his business at the {name:toll_camp} {dir_from_giver:toll_camp}, with enough borrowed ceremony to embarrass a coronation. Defeat five Toll Bandit Archers there and then Penn himself; his camp operates day and night. Keep clear of the other archers while you close on each one. I want him to discover that stamping a demand does not make it lawful.
quests.lesson: Archer camp plus its named normal leader.

quests.title: A Peg for the Bread Board
quests.text: My bread board rocks, and the royal kitchen has offered to lend me a peg with more conditions than a peace treaty. Bring me one Gnarled Boar Tusk from a Furrow Boar by day on the {name:commons}, which lies {zone_area:commons}. Their yellow names mean they only fight back when struck. I would rather settle the matter with the boar.
quests.lesson: A daytime errand that leaves your enchant stock alone.

quests.title: Optional: Venison for the Long Table
quests.text: The palace has ordered venison for a banquet and left the hunting to whoever happens to be standing near my oven. Bring down six Moss-Antler Stags by day in the {name:kingswood}, which lies {zone_area:kingswood}. Their yellow names mean they only fight back when struck, which is more patience than the banquet guests will show.
quests.lesson: Optional: neutral daytime game in the capital's wood.

quests.title: Pies Have Consequences
quests.text: The palace expects fruit pies, while the pickers expect to keep their fingers; I find the second request entirely reasonable. Hunt five Redfang Vixens by day in the {name:orchards}, which lie {zone_area:orchards}. Mind their red names: they start fights, unlike the Orchard Foxes sharing that ground.
quests.lesson: Aggressive and neutral foxes share one orchard.

quests.title: Bounty: Razorbacks
quests.text: The gardeners are replanting the {name:outer_fields}, {zone_area:outer_fields}, yet again, and the Razorbacks appear to regard this as attentive service. Bring down six by day and return for your bounty. I can pay for another hunt twenty-five minutes after you turn this one in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable bounty in the late outskirts.

quests.title: The Empty River Baskets
quests.text: I paid for river baskets and received a very confident promise, which has proved difficult to put bread in. Find Merren Oakstamp at Whitebridge Market Close in Whitebridge Shire and ask what became of my order. Follow the road, or visit the stables about a mount if your feet have already lodged a complaint.

quests.title: Bread for the March
quests.text: The watch at Cinderline eats my bread and stands between the Accord's homes and the fighting. Go to Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March and speak with Toren Waterbarrel; tell him the person who dealt with Penn is ready to help. Get yourself to level 30 before making the journey into contested country. Eat before you leave, too; courage is no breakfast.
